The application is disposed of.

3. The present petition under Section 528 of the BNSS (482 of the Cr.P.C.) seeks the following prayers:-
"It is, therefore, most humbly and respectfully prayed that this Hon' ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash and cancel of FIR No.1238 / 2014 U/ S 323/ 506/ 376/ 34 IPC P. S. New Usman Pur, Delhi and subsequent proceedings arising out of the said FIR, in the interest of justice."
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status
